name: @scout-for-lol/desktop
description: Pure-Rust desktop observer for Scout, with egui and gpui-kit windows

scripts.lint: mise exec -- cargo fmt --all -- --check && mise exec -- cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features --locked -- -D warnings
scripts.package:stable: SCOUT_DESKTOP_PROFILE=stable mise exec -- cargo packager --release --config packaging/stable.json
scripts.package:beta: SCOUT_DESKTOP_PROFILE=beta mise exec -- cargo packager --release --config packaging/beta.json
